statements: A few clients are hammering the API. Limit clients to 100 requests per minute.
A client over the limit gets the service's usual error shape with status 429 and a code of rate_limited, plus a header saying how many seconds to wait.
Time comes from the clock passed to createApp. Everything that exists today keeps working exactly as it does now.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add the request limit to the service, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and repository and change only what the ticket needs.
